name: Professor X
summary: The teacher with the biggest secret curriculum in comics. Charles Xavier, one of the world's strongest telepaths, founded the X-Men and runs a school for young mutants out of his New York mansion.
origin: Charles Xavier is the dad of the X-Men, which means he loves them and also keeps far too many secrets from them. He debuted in The X-Men #1 in 1963, already running a school for gifted youngsters out of his mansion in Westchester County, New York, which was really a training ground for teenage mutants. He is one of the most powerful telepaths on Earth, with a brilliant scientific mind, and he built Cerebro to track down new mutants. His dream of humans and mutants living side by side has driven the X-Men ever since, even when his methods are questionable. He has used a wheelchair for much of his history, and it has never slowed his scheming.
powers: Cerebro, which finds mutants around the world

storyline.title: The school
storyline.beat: Charles Xavier, a powerful telepath who uses a wheelchair, gathers teenage mutants at his school in Westchester, New York, and trains them as the X-Men.

storyline.title: Not really gone
storyline.beat: Xavier seems to die, but it turns out a shape-shifter had taken his place while the real Charles hid to prepare for an alien invasion.

storyline.title: Going global
storyline.beat: In Giant-Size X-Men #1 Xavier recruits an international team including Storm, Nightcrawler and Colossus, relaunching the franchise.

storyline.title: His own dark side
storyline.beat: Xavier's buried anger merges with Magneto's mind to create Onslaught, a villain who nearly destroys the heroes.

storyline.title: Killed by a student
storyline.beat: Xavier is killed by Cyclops, who is under the influence of the Phoenix Force.

storyline.title: A mutant nation
storyline.beat: Xavier, Magneto and Moira MacTaggert build the island nation of Krakoa as a home for all mutants.

gossip.text: His twin sister Cassandra Nova was introduced in 2001 and immediately ordered a Sentinel attack that wiped out Genosha.
The Juggernaut, Cain Marko, is his stepbrother.
The X-Mansion's address is 1407 Graymalkin Lane, Salem Center, New York.
Old comics blamed his paralysis on the alien villain Lucifer.
Patrick Stewart and James McAvoy have both played Xavier on film.

quiz.why: Cerebro boosts his power to find mutants.

quiz.q: What is the name of Xavier's evil twin sister?

theme.tagline: Reads minds. Rarely reads the room.

timeline.title: The school opens
timeline.note: The X-Men #1 introduces Charles Xavier, a bald telepath in a wheelchair who trains young mutants.

timeline.title: A faked death
timeline.note: X-Men #42 kills Xavier, though it later turns out a shape-shifter took his place while he hid.

timeline.title: Recruiting a global team
timeline.note: Giant-Size X-Men #1 has Xavier assemble new mutants from around the world.

timeline.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
timeline.note: The Fox Kids cartoon makes Xavier the steady voice of the X-Men for a young audience.

timeline.title: Onslaught
timeline.note: Xavier's dark side, mixed with Magneto's, becomes the giant villain Onslaught in a summer crossover.

timeline.title: Patrick Stewart in X-Men
timeline.note: Bryan Singer's film casts Patrick Stewart as Xavier, a role he played for nearly two decades.

timeline.title: Killed by his student
timeline.note: In Avengers vs. X-Men, a Phoenix-powered Cyclops kills his own mentor.

timeline.title: A mutant nation
timeline.note: House of X has Xavier found a mutant homeland on the living island of Krakoa.
